description: This file defines a PHP controller class QualificationMembershipController which extends AbstractVueController. It appears to be part of a web application, specifically handling qualification membership functionalities in the OrangeHRM system's admin plugin. The controller primarily sets up a Vue.js component for rendering the qualification membership list.

classes.name: QualificationMembershipController
classes.description: A controller class for managing qualification membership views within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends AbstractVueController and sets up a Vue component for rendering qualification membership list.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by instantiating a Vue component named 'qualification-membership-list' and assigning it to the controller.
